notes: Monochrome study of paper and type built as a single static page: the pulp section, an animated type-setting press, four drawn sheets, and a papermaking timeline. All text, diagrams, motion and interactivity are inline in index.html, styles.css and js/app.js — no external files, fonts or dependencies, and the page opens from file:// and from a GitHub Pages subfolder. Known limitation: reduced motion swaps the running press for static stepped angles, and the decorative hero sheet is a flat card.
